evidence.quote: Supply, Installation, Configuration, Integration and Maintenance of AI-powered Enterprise Extended Detection and Response (XDR) solution for a period of five (5) years
The proposed solution should have an integrated, generative AI-driven security assistant that should start contextually summarizing complex cross-layer incidents in natural language
The AI assistant must be powered by cybersecurity-specific large language models (LLMs) trained on the vendor's proprietary threat intelligence

key_facts.scope_summary: Supply, installation, and maintenance of an AI-powered XDR cybersecurity solution for 5 years.
